name: Vengeful Regrowth
oracle_text:
Return up to three target land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Create that many 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature tokens with reach.
Flashback {6}{G}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
blocked_sentences: Create that many 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature tokens with reach.

needs.what: a 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature token with reach
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list and holds no 4/2 Plant Warrior: the nearest are plant_0_1_g (0/1 Plant, no reach), rhino_warrior_4_4_g (4/4 Rhino Warrior) and spider_1_2_g_reach (1/2 Spider with reach), none of which is the printed token. The rest of the card is expressible: return_from_graveyard with tapped over an up_to card_in_graveyard land target, create_token amount as {targets_of_spell: t1} or a count of the returned cards, and card-level flashback.
